title: Six in ten films score between 5.5 and 7.5 on IMDb
subtitle: Distribution of IMDb user ratings (1–10) for 2,000 films released mostly 1990–2010
source: vega-datasets (movies.json; IMDb and The Numbers data)
note: Evenly spaced sample of 2,000 of the 2,988 rated films in the dataset.
description: User ratings pile up just above the midpoint (median 6.4), with a long tail of flops on the left.
author: sofia.g
